svg.title: IRE1 and PERK ER-membrane stress sensors
svg.desc: UPR branches are schematic and context-dependent. ATF6 is transported to the Golgi before proteolytic release; the released transcription factor derives from its cytosolic domain. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.

Plasma membrane; extracellular above, cytoplasm below
